notes: Two sub-variants, as for high_voltage_three_stage. Transcribed: 尖峰時間固定 (lines 896-923). Not transcribed: 尖峰時間可變動 (lines 924-956), whose summer designated-day 尖峰 is 17.05 for 特高壓 (line 925).
Chapter 5 tables print four price columns: 高壓供電 夏月, 非夏月, then 特高壓供電 夏月, 非夏月 (lines 888-891). This plan takes columns 3 and 4; every cited line was checked to have exactly four price-or-dash tokens.
非夏月 has no 尖峰 (line 896 non-summer column is —). Price-line versus window-line placement as in high_voltage_three_stage (898, 902, 914).
Basic fee formula: 當月經常契約電價x經常契約容量 + 當月半尖峰契約電價x半尖峰契約容量 + 當月週六半尖峰或離峰契約電價x[(週六半尖峰+離峰)-(經常+半尖峰)x0.5], last term floored at 0 (lines 1049-1054). 半尖峰契約 is billed in both seasons.
Lines 1074-1076: customers with their own 161,000 V substation get 2% off the 特高壓 basic fee; own 345,000 V substation, 4.2% off.

Lines 1072-1073: 儲冷式空調 chillers pay 60% of the applicable off-peak energy price. Lines 1064-1065: zero-use month pays 50% basic fee. Lines 1129-1133: over-contract demand 2x/3x basic fee. Lines 1160-1164: 4.8x/1.6x rule for 週六半尖峰-only or 離峰-only contracts.
Line 1008: customers under 電價調整係數 follow 附錄一. Lines 1004-1007: Taipower may shift period boundaries for special loads while keeping daily hours.
sunday_holiday covers 週日及離峰日; the 離峰日 list is at lines 985-997.
